stories.title: Neighbors raise safety concerns after Bay to Bay Boulevard project canceled
stories.summary: Tampa Mayor Jane Castor said this project started about five years ago following a crash on Bay to Bay Boulevard and Lois Avenue that killed two teenagers.

stories.title: Hernando substitute teacher arrested for alleged relationship with 17-year-old student
stories.summary: Deputies say detectives found explicit photos of the substitute teacher on a 17-year-old student's phone.

stories.title: Robin Lockett appointed to Tampa City Council District 7 seat, replacing Luis Viera
stories.summary: Lockett secured the four votes needed on the first ballot but says she will not run in the March election to fill the seat for a full term.

stories.title: 15-year-old girl attacked while walking her dog in Polk County; man arrested
stories.summary: Deputies say the suspect's family stopped the attack and called law enforcement.

stories.title: Muslim prayer sparks backlash at Bartow City Commission meeting
stories.summary: A Muslim prayer leader opened the Bartow City Commission meeting Monday, prompting a wave of public comments and debate over religious freedom.

stories.title: FHP: Motorcyclist sought for hit-and-run in Pasco County
stories.summary: FHP says the motorcyclist sped away from troopers traveling more than 100 mph before hitting an SUV and fleeing the scene in Pasco County.

stories.title: Sanding Ovations returns to Treasure Island for 2026: Schedule, parking, and sculptures
stories.summary: This year's theme, "Music Is the Key," invites artists to create sculptures inspired by music.

stories.title: VIDEO: Hillsborough deputy rescues 2-year-old girl from pond
stories.summary: Just seven minutes after responding to a 911 call from her mother, deputies safely rescued a 2-year-old girl from a pond at a Brandon apartment complex.

stories.title: Florida Cabinet approves $20.5 million Clearwater land buy to expand Caladesi Island State Park
stories.summary: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis and Cabinet members approved the purchase during their Tuesday morning meeting.

stories.title: The American Legion in Safety Harbor dedicates bench to Jessica Antolini
stories.summary: Antolini died after being shot and run over by her boyfriend near a downtown bar on Oct. 15.

stories.title: Citrus County deputies investigating death in Homosassa neighborhood
stories.summary: The Citrus County Sheriff's Office asked neighbors to avoid the area while the death investigation continues.

stories.title: Tampa breaks road paving record for 2nd consecutive year, city officials say
stories.summary: The city says it has paved four more miles of roadway than it did in 2025, with just two months left in the year.
